question: Did every record get migrated by the scripts you ran? Answer yes or no, then say how many, if any, were skipped.
answer: No. 3 of the 1250 legacy records were skipped: IDs 311, 702 and 1049. All three have a NULL `name` in `legacy_accounts`, which the `NOT NULL` constraint on `accounts.name` rejects. The other 1247 were migrated, so those 3 users still can't log in until someone decides how to handle them.
